title: Curiousity: an offline-first interactive STEM learning app
description: Curiousity is a free, permanently free, offline-first learning app built around the Teddy Rook Book corpus. It ships interactive figures, deterministic practice generators, a mastery and spaced-review engine, and 23 additional learning tools. Application code is MIT; the lesson corpus is CC BY-NC 4.0; Marble standards data is ODbL 1.0 / CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: DOI minted per release. Attach dist/ from the tagged build to the deposit so the citation resolves to the exact version.
